acknowledgment: Shared-site handoff only; no separate-chat receipt or acceptance claimed.
scope: Locomotive frame, machinery mounts, driving station, exterior trim. Tender retained unchanged this phase.
current_DT: DT5 R1; spring-space reservation240 replaces earlier305; do not reuse archived DT3 masses/rates.
required_from_drivetrain: Configured pump, bellhousing and coupling OEM CAD, mass/CG, input power/torque and torsional approval
Complete truck/body reactions and loaded train mass with brakes, wheelsets, motor carriers, guards and fluids
Selected springs/dampers within240mm reservation, usable jounce/rebound and actual installed lengths
Combined truck, brake, motor, hose sweep at minimum route radius and suspension extremes
Traction lever physical/interface specification; neutral/start, enable, fault, reversal and loss-of-command behavior
required_from_brakes: Brake controller boundary and connection type; lever stroke and operating force
Service/parking status feedback and traction-inhibit requirements; pressure system if applicable
Fail-safe behavior, emergency stop coordination and release interlocks; test acceptance criteria
required_from_engine_supplier: Exact engine variant/continuous derated power versus site ambient/altitude and duty
Configured engine foot pattern, shaft centre, lifting points, wet mass/CG, service/extraction envelope
Flywheel housing, coupling/pump interface and torsional compatibility
Coolant/CAC/oil heat rejection and fan performance; cooling air restrictions
DOC/DPF/regen layout, surface temperatures, allowable exhaust backpressure and shielding
Fuel supply/return/filter/vent data; ECU wiring, J1939 compatibility and start/stop/e-stop instructions
CAD and dimensioned PDF for exact engine order code, all mount-hole coordinates/thread engagement, mounting-pad flatness, flywheel SAE pattern/shaft axis and allowable overhung/moment loads
Operating mass and three-axis CG for engine plus DOC/DPF, oil/coolant inventories, starter/alternator/fan options; identify excluded auxiliaries
Coolant and charge-air heat rejection at continuous rated duty and duty map, coolant flow/restriction/thermostat data, permitted CAC pressure drop, fan curve and installed airflow restriction limits
DPF regeneration temperature/keep-out and allowed orientation, service intervals and removal paths; supported shutdown method and residual-cooling requirements

Configured service-side drawing: oil/fuel/air filters, drains/fill/dipstick, belt service, starter/alternator and DPF removal sweeps, lifting points and rigging. Dedicated routine hatches required; major shell panels about59kg each with ribs.

signals: Traction command and loss-of-command neutral response
Service brake demand and available/released status
Parking brake applied status and drive inhibit
Independent emergency-stop request to coordinated brake/engine/drive system
Gate state; horn; forward/reverse lights; work lights
Engine speed, oil pressure, coolant temperature, charge voltage, DPF/regen status
